name: Blockchain
summary: Cibiyoyin sadarwar da ke rikodin kuma amintattun ma'amaloli
blurb: Litattafan da aka raba tare da ijma'i - layin sasantawa komai yana zaune a kai. Kowane labarin ya ƙunshi cikakkun bayanai, mahimman bayanai, da shawarwari.

items.title: Bitcoin
items.summary: Cibiyar sadarwar tsabar kuɗi ta farko-da-tsara ta farko tare da ƙayyadaddun ƙa'idodin bayarwa
items.intro: Bitcoin yana nuna yadda ƙimar za ta iya motsawa akan intanet ba tare da banki a matsayin alkalin wasa ba. Saitin nodes na duniya yana raba littatafai ɗaya amintattu ta hanyar rufaffiyar asiri da ƙarfafawa. Don masu farawa, maɓallai, UTXOs, da dokokin bayarwa suna da mahimmanci fiye da jadawalin farashin ɗan gajeren lokaci.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body:
Amintattun masu shiga tsakani na iya daskare asusu, toshe biyan kuɗi, ko kasawa cikin rikici. Bitcoin ya maye gurbin izinin hukuma tare da tabbatarwa jama'a: kowa zai iya bincika tarihin, yayin sake rubutawa an tsara shi don ya zama mai tsada sosai. 
Toshewar asali har ma ya haɗa kanun jarida game da bailouts na banki - siginar ganganci game da ƙa'idodin kuɗi a cikin lamba.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body:
Kuna sanya hannu kan ma'amala da ke kashe abubuwan da ba a kashewa ba (UTXOs) zuwa sabbin adireshi. Masu hakar ma'adinai suna gasa ta hanyar hujja-na-aiki don haɗa tubalan da samun lada. 
Halvings rage sabon wadata a kan lokaci; Wahala tana daidaitawa don haka tubalan su kasance a tsaye. Ƙarin tabbaci yana nufin ƙananan haɗarin sake haɓakawa.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Maɓallai masu zaman kansu daidai gwargwado; adireshi na iya zama jama'a. Kudade kasuwa ne don toshe sarari. Rubutun Bitcoin yana da iyaka da gangan, don haka yana nuna kamar daidaitawa da ƙarancin dijital fiye da dandamali na aikace-aikacen gabaɗaya.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Ƙarfafawa ba bug na yarjejeniya ba ne. Tsabar kudi akan musayar IOUs har sai an cire su. Fitar, goyan bayan karya, da kuma hanyar sadarwar da ba daidai ba suna haifar da asara ta dindindin-yi aiki tare da ƙaramin adadin farko.

keyPoints: Bitcoin cibiyar sadarwar sasantawa ce ta jama'a, ba alamar kamfani ba.
Ka'idojin bayarwa da suka haɗa da ragi ana aiwatar da su ta ka'ida da ƙarfafawa.
UTXO + sa hannu suna ayyana canja wuri; maɓallan da suka ɓace suna nufin asarar kuɗi.
Tsaro galibi shine mahimmancin tsafta da halayen tabbatarwa.
tips: Gwada karɓa/aika tare da sanannen ko jakar kayan masarufi.
Matsar da girman a batches kuma jira isassun tabbaci.
Ajiye nau'in a layi daya - kar a taɓa yin hoto ko aika saƙon sa.

items.title: Ethereum
items.summary: Babban manufar blockchain don kwangiloli masu wayo — galibi ana kiransa kwamfuta ta duniya
items.intro: Inda Bitcoin ke mayar da hankali kan canja wurin kuɗi, Ethereum yana mai da hankali kan aiwatar da ka'idodin shirye-shirye. Yarjejeniyar kaddarorin tsarewa, rufaffen yanayi, da tsara cikin aikace-aikace. Bayan Haɗuwa, yarjejeniya ita ce hujja-ta-kangi yayin da kisa ya kasance EVM.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body:
Biyan kuɗi kaɗai ba zai iya bayyana lamuni, musaya, ko tsarin mulki cikin tsafta ba. Injin kama-da-wane da aka raba yana juya lamba zuwa abubuwan more rayuwa na jama'a. 
Buɗe musaya yana barin alamomi da ƙa'idodi su shiga juna-tushen Legos DeFi.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body:
EOAs suna sarrafa maɓalli; ana sarrafa lambobin kwangila. Kuna biyan iskar gas don sauye-sauyen jihohi. Masu tabbatarwa suna ɗaukar ETH don ba da shawara da shaida; za a iya yanke manyan laifuffuka. 
Masu amfani har yanzu suna mu'amala ta hanyar sa hannu na walat, amma sararin ƙirar ya fi fa'ida fiye da sauƙin canja wuri.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Ƙididdigar mita gas. Ma'auni na Token (ERC-20/721) yana ba da damar walat da daidaituwar kasuwa. Layer 2 yana motsa kisa daga mainnet yayin da yake komawa ga amincin Ethereum.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: "A kan Ethereum" ≠ duba ko lafiya. Amincewa marar iyaka da alamun karya suna zubar da walat ɗin. Kudade kololuwa na iya wuce girman ciniki — duba hanyar sadarwa, kwangila, da iyakar izini.

keyPoints: Ethereum na'ura ce ta jihar da aka raba tare da lokacin aikin kwangilar wayo.
PoS yana tabbatar da yarjejeniya; EVM yana aiwatar da aikace-aikacen.
Ƙididdiga suna sa kadarori su yi mu'amala da juna a cikin yanayin muhalli.
Tsaro ya dogara da ingancin kwangila, yarda, da gadoji.
tips: Tabbatar da adiresoshin kwangila a cikin toshe mai bincike, ba ta ticker kadai ba.
Yi amfani da L2s na hukuma ko jira lokacin da mainnet ke cunkoso.
Gwada sababbin ka'idoji tare da kuɗin da za ku iya rasa.

items.title: Ijma'i
items.summary: Yadda hanyar sadarwa ta yarda akan tarihin canonical ɗaya
items.intro: Ba tare da alkalin wasa na tsakiya ba, nodes har yanzu suna buƙatar littafi guda. Ijma'i yana bayyana wanda ya ba da shawarar toshe, yadda ake azabtar da masu yaudara, da lokacin da canja wuri ya isa ƙarshe. Tabbacin-aiki da hujja-hannun hannu hanyoyi ne daban-daban don sa sake rubuta tarihin ya zama tsada.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body:
Mahalarta da aka rarraba zasu iya jinkirta, cire haɗin, ko yin ƙarya. Ijma'i yana hana kashe kuɗi biyu ta hanyar sanya tarihi daya mamaye tattalin arziki. 
Ga masu amfani, yana ƙayyade lokutan jira, sake haɗarin haɗari, da farashin harin.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body:
Farashin PoW yana kai hari da makamashi/hashrate. Farashin PoS yana kai hare-hare tare da babban jari da yankewa. Wasu ka'idoji suna ba da ƙarƙarar ƙarshe bayan wuraren bincike; wasu kuma masu yiwuwa ne. 
Musanya sun saita tabbacin ajiya daga waɗannan kaddarorin.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Rayuwa vs aminci ciniki-offs al'amura. Sarkar “mafi sauri” tare da ƙananan saiti masu inganci na iya raunana juriyar tantancewa. Tambayi wanda ke samar da tubalan kafin bikin TPS.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Maganganu ba abubuwan saka hannun jari bane. Gada da zato-hasken abokin ciniki sau da yawa sun fi rauni fiye da yarjejeniya ta tushe-kuma a nan ne yawancin hacks suka sauka.

keyPoints: Ijma'i yana zaɓar tarihin canonical guda ɗaya a cikin nodes marasa amana.
Farashin PoW da PoS suna kai hari daban.
Tabbatattun / ƙarshe sun yanke shawarar lokacin da aka “karɓi kuɗi.”
Abubuwan haɗin ketare na iya zama mai rauni fiye da labarin L1.
tips: Girmama shawarar tabbatarwa ƙidaya don manyan adibas.
Bincika rarraba mai inganci da ka'idojin yankewa akan sabbin sarƙoƙi.
Rage gada/ayyukan ba da damar aiki yayin haɓaka rikice-rikice.

items.title: Asusu & Maɓallai
items.summary: Asalin kan-sarkar maɓalli ne, ba sake saita sunan mai amfani ta hanyar goyan baya ba
items.intro: Asusunka yawanci adireshi ne da aka samo daga maɓalli na sirri. Babu wanda zai iya sake saita muku wannan maɓallin; sa hannu shine izini. Fahimtar EOAs, lissafin kwangila, da jimlolin iri shine tushen amintaccen amfani.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Web2 asusun suna rayuwa akan sabar kamfani tare da sake saitin kalmar sirri. Blockchains suna tura iko zuwa masu riƙe da mahimmanci don tsare kansu - kuma suna tura alhakin aiki tare da shi.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Maɓallai masu zaman kansu suna samun maɓalli da adireshi na jama'a. Tsari (BIP-39) na iya sabunta asusu da yawa a cikin sarƙoƙi. Asusun kwangila yana motsa kuɗi ta hanyoyi masu lamba; wayayyun asusu sun haɗa manufofi kamar iyaka da masu kulawa.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Wallets masu zafi suna dacewa; walat ɗin kayan masarufi suna adana maɓalli a cikin amintaccen kashi. Multisig yana yada iko. Iri daya da aka zube na iya lalata duk bishiyar da aka samu.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Hotunan kariyar gajimare, malware, da buƙatun iri na “tallafawa” hanyoyin asara ce ta yau da kullun. Sa hannun makaho na iya amincewa da magudanar ruwa - ƙin rashin tabbas.

keyPoints: Maɓallai daidai ikon mallaka.
Ana iya raba adireshi; tsaba ba.
EOAs na ɗan adam ne; Kwangiloli suna sarrafa lamba.
Karanta iyakar izini kafin sanya hannu.
tips: Ware kuɗin gwaji daga walat ɗin ajiya.
Rubuta iri akan takarda/karfe kuma adana a layi.
Kunna simintin ciniki akan sabbin dApps.

items.title: Gas & Kudade
items.summary: Ana ƙididdige kowane canjin jiha don haka ba za a iya yin ɓarna a kwamfutar jama'a kyauta ba
items.intro: Gas ba haraji na sabani ba ne - yana farashin ƙididdigewa da ajiya. Kudin ku shine farashin amfani × naúrar. Cunkoso yana haɓaka farashin rukunin, wanda shine dalilin da ya sa aikin iri ɗaya zai iya kashe cents ko dubun daloli.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Jama'a blockchains dole ne a daure albarkatun. Gas yana haifar da kasuwa mai ƙima: mafi girma farashin bayyana farko; masu haɓakawa dole ne su rubuta kwangila masu inganci.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Canje-canje masu sauƙi suna ɗan ƙaramin gas; hadaddun hanyoyin DeFi sun fi tsada. Bayan EIP-1559, kudade na tushe suna ƙonewa da shawarwarin biyan masu ba da shawara. L2s suna rage farashin bayanan L1 a tsakanin masu amfani da yawa, don haka farashin naúrar ya ragu.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Iyakar iskar iskar gas ta iyakance nawa kuke ba da izini. Har yanzu ma'amalolin da ba su yi nasara ba na iya cajin iskar gas saboda kisa ya faru. Saurin-sauri/ soke yana maye gurbin da ba mai jira ba tare da ƙarin kuɗi tx.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Shafukan karya na iya haifar da iskar gas ko kiran banza. Kamfen "Zero gas" sau da yawa yana faɗaɗa izini-tambayi wanda ke tallafawa da abin da kuka ba da izini.

keyPoints: Kisa na mita gas; farashin kasuwa ne.
Rashin gazawa na iya kashe iskar gas.
L2s da batching sune manyan masu tara kuɗi.
Karɓar ƙarancin kuɗi ko buƙatun amincewa.
tips: Yi ayyukan da ba na gaggawa ba daga kololuwa ko kan L2.
Yi amfani da ƙididdigar kuɗin walat da kwaikwaya.
Farashin jimillar iskar gas kafin yaƙin neman zaɓe na matakai da yawa.

items.title: Gada
items.summary: Tashoshin da ke motsa ƙima ko saƙonni a cikin sarƙoƙi-da maƙasudin hack akai-akai
items.intro: Kayayyaki ba sa bayyana da sihiri a kan wani littafin. Kulle gada, mint, ƙonewa, ko musanya ta hanyar ruwa-yawan samun dama yayin tattara haɗari. Yawancin manyan fa'idodi na tarihi sun sami tsare gada da tabbatarwa.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Ba tare da gadoji ba, yanayin muhalli yana zama tsibirai. Tare da gadoji, masu amfani suna samun ƙarin amana da haɗarin kwangila don musanyawa don motsi.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Samfuran sun haɗa da kulle-da-mint, ƙona-da-fansa, hanyoyin sadarwar ruwa, da relays abokin ciniki mai haske. Canonical rollup gadoji sun gaji tsaro na jujjuyawa amma suna iya samun jinkirin fita; gada masu sauri suna ƙara zato na ɓangare na uku don saurin gudu.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Za a iya fanshi 1:1? Ta yaya ake karkasa masu inganci? Babban TVL na iya nufin manufa mai kiba, ba aminci ta atomatik ba.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Yankunan phishing suna bunƙasa a kusa da gadoji. Hanyar sadarwar da ba daidai ba ko kwangilar alamar tana aika kuɗi zuwa ɓoyayye. Koyaushe gwada tare da ƙaramin canja wuri da farko.

keyPoints: Gada yarjejeniya ce ta giciye, ba wayar tarho ba.
Canonical vs gada masu sauri suna da samfuran amana daban-daban.
Gada sun mamaye asarar hack na tarihi.
Tabbatar da yanki, kwangila, da hanyar sadarwa tare.
tips: Shigar da gadoji daga takaddun hukuma masu alamar kawai.
Gwada mafi ƙarancin girma kafin girman girman motsi.
Bi da fitattun hanyoyin da ba za a iya kashe su ba tukuna.

name: DeFi
summary: Bayar da lamuni, musanyawa da rarrabuwa ta hanyar kwangiloli masu wayo
blurb: Yadda buɗaɗɗen kuɗin kuɗi ke haɗawa-da kuma kasada a kusa da rates, liquidations, da stables.

items.title: Masu yin Kasuwa Na atomatik
items.summary: Wuraren ruwa na ruwa da masu lankwasa farashin suna maye gurbin littattafan oda na gargajiya
items.intro: AMMs suna barin kowa ya saka alamun a cikin tafkin don 'yan kasuwa su iya musanya da dabara. Kuna samun ci gaba da biyan kuɗi da kuma kuɗin LP-da hasara mara nauyi da haɗarin kwangilar wayo.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Littattafai na kan layi suna da tsada. Pools suna kiyaye yawan ruwa a cikin kwangiloli don haka musanyawa na iya faruwa kowane lokaci, dimokraɗiyya yin kasuwa.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Constant-samfurin shi ne classic kwana; Stableswaps da tattara kudi mai yawa suna inganta ingantaccen babban jari. Masu ba da hanya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa sun raba sana'o'i a fadin wuraren waha. Iyakoki na zamewa suna kare ku lokacin da jiha ta motsa.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Rashin hasara mai mahimmanci zai iya sa LPs ba su cika aiki ba. Alamu na karya da sandunan zuma na iya kama da siya amma ba za a iya siyarwa ba. APRs na fitar da hayaki bazai dawwama ba.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Amincewa marar iyaka ga masu amfani da hanyoyin da ba a san su ba suna da haɗari. Depegs damuwa "barga" wuraren waha wuya.

keyPoints: Farashin AMMs ta hanyar lissafin ruwa don musanyawa nan take.
LPs suna samun kuɗi kuma suna ɗaukar haɗarin kwangilar IL +.
Sakamakon ingantacciyar hanyar zamewa da kwatance.
Tabbatar da wuraren waha/alamu kafin neman yawan amfanin ƙasa.
tips: Saita zamewa matsi da mafi ƙarancin adadin.
Fi son wuraren tafki masu zurfi akan manyan ladabi.
Cire alawus-alawus na alamar da ba a yi amfani da su akai-akai.

items.title: Ka'idojin Ba da Lamuni
items.summary: Ƙunƙarar rancen da aka haɗa tare da ƙimar algorithmic da yawan ruwa
items.intro: Ajiye kadarorin don samun albarkatu ko rance akan jingina ba tare da tebur ɗin kiredit ba. Abubuwan kiwon lafiya, baka, da bots na ruwa-ba masu gudanar da dangantaka ba- suna kiyaye tsarin narkewa.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Aiwatar da kan sarkar bashi bashi da wahala yana da wahala, don haka wuce gona da iri ya mamaye. Kowa na iya shiga; babban tasiri shine ciniki-off.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Amfani yana motsa sha'awa. Oracle yana ciyar da farashin. Lokacin da lafiya ta faɗi, masu ba da ruwa suna biya bashi kuma su karɓi lamuni don kari.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Hanyoyin keɓewa, LTV, da zamantakewa mara kyau-bashi sun bambanta ta hanyar yarjejeniya. Leverage leverage yana haɓaka haɗari. Net APR dole ne ya cire gas da kuma hukuncin kisa.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Oracle lag ko magudi na iya haifar da ruwa mara kyau. Ma'anar bayar da lamuni a matsayin "lafiya ta tanadi" tarkon tunani ne.

keyPoints: Overcollateralization + liquidations sune ainihin.
Abubuwan kiwon lafiya sun doke farashin kanun labarai.
Oracle da ingancin ruwa sun yanke shawarar aminci.
Leverage madaukai suna ƙara fa'ida.
tips: Bar babban buffer sama da ruwa.
Guji haɗin kai sosai a cikin guguwa.
Yi ƙididdige farashin ƙima kafin aro.

items.title: Stablecoins
items.summary: Ƙungiyoyin kan-sarkar da aka ƙirƙira don bin diddigin madaidaicin tunani kamar USD
items.intro: Ƙididdiga masu ƙima suna da banƙyama don farashi da lissafin kuɗi. Stablecoins suna ba da dogo mai kama da dala don ciniki da aika kuɗi-amma hanyoyin da yanayin gazawa sun bambanta sosai.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Suna ba da rukunin asusun da aka sani don ayyukan sarkar da matsuguni na ɗan lokaci a cikin lokutan haɗari - mafaka ≠ mara haɗari.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: tsabar kudi masu goyon bayan Fiat sun dogara da tanadi da fansa; crypto-goyan baya a kan overconlateralization; ƙirar algorithmic suna daidaita wadata kuma sun tabbatar da rauni. Bayyana gaskiya da sharuɗɗan fansa suna cikin damuwa.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Daskarewa, depegs, nau'ikan sarkar giciye na jabu, da nade-naden da ake samu suna ƙara haɗarin haɗari. Ticker iri ɗaya akan wani sarkar na iya zama mara hukuma.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: USD a cikin sunan talla ne, ba inshora ba. Tattaunawa a cikin mai bayarwa ɗaya shine haɗarin takwaransa.

keyPoints: Stablecoins kayan aikin ne tare da haɗarin mai bayarwa/makanikanci.
Ajiye, lamuni, ko algorithms suna kasawa daban.
Manufofin fansa da daskare suna shafar amfani.
Koyaushe tabbatar da kwangilar hukuma kowace sarkar.
tips: Fi son ƙira mai iya fanshi bayyane don girman girman.
Bambance masu fitarwa da wuraren zama.
Kula da girman “tsayayyen amfanin gona” azaman gargaɗi.

items.title: Staking & Restaking
items.summary: Babban haɗin gwiwa don tabbatar da hanyar sadarwa-kuma wani lokacin sake amfani da wannan tsaro

items.intro: Zaɓuɓɓukan kyakkyawan fata suna aiwatarwa akan L2, aika bayanai zuwa Ethereum, kuma suna ɗaukar daidaito sai dai in an ƙalubalanci. Masu amfani suna samun rahusa UX; ficewar canonical na iya jira lokacin ƙalubale.

sections.body: L1 toshe sarari yana da tsada. Matsar da kashe sarkar yayin da aka jingina zuwa L1 yana rage farashi. An aika da ƙirar ƙira da wuri tare da ƙarfin ƙarfin EVM.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Mai bibiya yana yin odar ma'amaloli kuma yana buga batches; Tushen jihar akan L1. A lokacin taga, masu kallo zasu iya jayayya. Fitowa da sauri suna amfani da ruwa na ɓangare na uku tare da ƙarin zato.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Ƙaddamar da ma'auni, samuwan bayanai, da maɓallan haɓakawa suna bayyana tsaro na gaske. Gudun UX ≠ ya gama rarrabawa.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Yin watsi da ficewar yana jinkirin rashin biyan kuɗi. Shafukan gada na karya suna karuwa a duk lokacin da yanayin L2s.

keyPoints: Kalubalanci jinkirin cinikin windows don mafi sauƙaƙan hujjojin zamba.
Tsaro yana dogara akan bayanan L1 + wasannin jayayya.
Canonical gadoji suna da hankali amma sun fi bayyana.
Sequencer uptime shine haɗarin kwarewa.
tips: Shirin L1 yana fita tare da jinkirin tunani.
Fi son wuraren shiga gada na hukuma.
Karanta takardun tsere-hatch don fitar da jerin abubuwan.

items.title: Farashin ZK
items.summary: Tabbatattun hujjoji sun shawo kan L1 cewa batches L2 daidai ne

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Scale ba tare da dogara ga "zaton gaskiya sai dai idan an kalubalanci." Saurin daidaitawa yana taimakawa musanya da gadoji.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: L2 aiki; masu fa'ida suna gina hujjoji; Masu tabbatar da L1 suna duba su. Mafi girman daidaitattun EVM yana sauƙaƙe ƙaura na app.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Tsarin tabbaci, DA, da maɓallan haɓakawa har yanzu suna da mahimmanci. Alamar "ZK" ≠ kasuwannin da ba a daidaita su ba tukuna.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Ƙididdigar ƙididdiga/masu-biyu na iya zama. Gada da phishing har yanzu suna mamaye asarar masu amfani.

keyPoints: Tabbatattun tabbaci suna ƙarfafa garantin daidai.
Hardware/injiniya yana kashe sifar kuɗaɗe da rarrabawa.
Masu amfani har yanzu suna buƙatar tsabtace gada da walat.
Daidaituwar EVM tana tafiyar da jigilar mahalli.
tips: Bincika taswirorin karkasa tsarin mulki na prover.
Gwada gadoji tare da ƙananan kuɗi.
Karanta zanen DA a hankali.

items.title: Samun Bayanai
items.summary: Tabbatar da kowa zai iya samun bayanan da ake buƙata don sake gina jihar
items.intro: Rollups dole ne su sa a sami bayanan ma'amala. Idan bayanai sun ɓace, masu amfani na iya kasa fita lafiya. Blobs ya rage farashin Ethereum DA kuma ya taimaka matsawa kuɗin L2.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Hujjoji ba tare da bayanai ba har yanzu na iya kama masu amfani da tarko. Inda bayanai ke rayuwa-da kuma yadda suke da tsada-yana zaune a tsakiyar muhawara.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Bayanai na iya zama a cikin Ethereum calldata/blobs ko na waje DA yadudduka, sau da yawa tare da samfurin / goge coding. Gadon tsaro ya bambanta da ƙira.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: "An daidaita zuwa Ethereum" baya kama da "DA daidai da cikakken garantin Ethereum." Faɗin kuɗin sau da yawa yana bin mai arha DA.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Rashin kimanta yanayin gazawar DA yana da haɗari. Talla na iya ɓata daidaituwa da samuwa.

keyPoints: Ba tare da DA ba, ceton kai yana raunana.
Haɓaka-zamanin Blob sun canza maɓallan kuɗin L2.
Zaɓuɓɓukan DA suna ɗaukar zato daban-daban.
Kudaden alkalai, aminci, da raba gari tare.
tips: Karanta kowane sashin L2 na DA.
Riƙe bayanan kuɓuta na hukuma mai amfani.
Kada ku sanya sarƙoƙi ta TPS kaɗai.
items.body: Rollups dole ne su sa a sami bayanan ma'amala. Idan bayanai sun ɓace, masu amfani na iya kasa fita lafiya. Blobs ya rage farashin Ethereum DA kuma ya taimaka matsawa kuɗin L2.

items.title: L2 Gada
items.summary: Canonical tare da hanyoyi na ɓangare na uku tsakanin L1 da L2
items.intro: Canonical gadoji sun gaji ka'idodin jujjuyawa kuma suna iya zama a hankali; gadoji na ɓangare na uku suna sayar da sauri tare da ƙarin amana. Zaɓin UI mara kyau shine babban tsarin asara.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Kuna buƙatar kuɗi akan L2 don UX mai arha, ko baya akan L1 don daidaitawa. Masu amfani daban-daban suna zaɓar madaidaicin amana/latency mabambanta.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Haɓaka ma'auni na L2 na hukuma bayan ajiya da fita kowace ƙa'idodin naɗa. Mai sauri gadoji gaban ruwa da sake daidaitawa daga baya-kudaden agogo da iyaka.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Sahihancin yanki, haɓakawa, iyakoki, da hanyoyin dawo da kuɗi suna da mahimmanci. Mafi sauri yawanci yana nufin ƙarin takwarorinsu.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Bincika-ad tallace-tallace na karya. Ƙirƙirar sigar alamar da ba daidai ba ta daidaita yawan ruwa. Bayar da kuɗi har yanzu yana cikin ƙalubalantar haɗarin windows-mis-marks.

keyPoints: Canonical gadoji sun dace da zato mafi kyau.
Fast gadoji kasuwanci amana na lokaci.
Tabbatar da yanki ya zama tilas.
Ƙananan gwaje-gwaje kafin girma.
tips: Danna gadoji daga rukunin yanar gizon L2.
Ajiye hashes tx don tallafi/debugging.
Ka guji sabbin gadoji waɗanda ba a tantance su ba don girman.

items.title: Abstraction Account
items.summary: Wallet ɗin kwangila mai wayo tare da farfadowa, iyakoki, da iskar gas mai ɗaukar nauyi
items.intro: Classic EOAs na nufin jimlolin iri da iskar gas mai biyan kuɗi. AA yana ba wa wallet damar ayyana dabaru na tabbatarwa-masu tsaro, maɓallan zaman, batching, masu biyan kuɗi-don haka hawan jirgi yana jin kusanci da Web2 ba tare da cikakken barin tsare kai ba.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Tsaba suna tsoratar da sababbin masu zuwa; iskar gas ya ruɗe su. AA yana rage gogayya yayin da ake kiyaye iko mai tabbatarwa. dApps suna samun ƙarancin buguwa ta hanyar zama da batches.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: UserOperations an haɗa su akan sarkar; masu biyan albashi na iya daukar nauyin kudade. Kwangilolin walat suna tilasta manufofi. Matsayi kamar ERC-4337 sun bambanta ta hanyar balaga.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Su wane ne masu tsaro? Shin farfadowa ya kasance a tsakiya? Shin izinin zama yayi yawa? Misconfig har yanzu yana asarar kuɗi.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: "Babu iri" ≠ babu kasada-ana iya kai hari kan tashoshi na farfadowa. Akwai madaidaitan ma'auni/masu biyan kuɗi. Zama zuwa dApps da ba a san su ba suna da haɗari.

Gas da aka tallafawa da farfadowar zamantakewa sune nasarar kanun labarai UX.
Kanfigareshan yana zaɓar tsaro na gaske.
Har yanzu phishing yana aiki idan kun yarda a makance.
tips: Zabi masu kulawa da na'urori daban-daban.

items.title: Gaskiyar sarkar da yawa
items.summary: Rarraba ruwa da masu amfani a cikin yankuna da yawa
items.intro: Mutane kaɗan ne ke rayuwa akan sarka ɗaya yanzu. Alamomin gas, gadoji, da tura aikace-aikacen sun bambanta. Masu warware niyya suna ɓoye hanyoyi, amma har yanzu dole ne ku san inda kuɗi ke zaune.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Sarkar ɗaya ba za ta iya inganta kowane kuɗin kuɗi / aiki ba. Ƙarin zaɓi kuma yana nufin ƙarin hanyoyin da za a zaɓi hanyar sadarwa mara kyau.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Wallets canza RPC / ID na sarkar; adireshin iri ɗaya na iya ɗaukar kadarori daban-daban a kowace sarkar EVM. Gada da saƙon suna haɗa jihohi; masu warware matsalar suna gasa don cika niyya.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Sahihancin ID na sarkar, RPCs na karya, da kwangiloli na kowane sarkar safa ne na yau da kullun. Ma'aunin sifili galibi yana nufin hanyar sadarwa mara kyau da aka zaɓa.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Sa hannu na yaudara na al'ada RPCs. Girgiza taga yana ƙara haɗari. Yada kudaden da ba za a iya maye gurbinsu ba a cikin sabbin L2s guda goma bashi ne na aiki.

keyPoints: Multi sarkar al'ada ne - tabbatar da cibiyoyin sadarwa koyaushe.
Adireshi iri ɗaya ≠ ma'auni iri ɗaya a ko'ina.
Maƙasudai suna ɓoye rikitarwa; ba sa goge haɗarin gada.
Ƙananan sarƙoƙi masu aiki suna rage kurakurai.
tips: Lakabi cibiyoyin sadarwa a sarari a cikin walat ɗin ku.
Hoton hoto/duba sunayen cibiyar sadarwa kafin aikawa.
Koyi hanyoyin fita kafin sakawa cikin sabuwar sarka.

items.title: Me yasa Kudaden L2 na iya zama Cents
items.summary: Batching da arha bayanai suna rage farashin L1 a tsakanin masu amfani da yawa
items.intro: A kan cunkoson L1 kuna yin tayin neman ƙarancin toshe wuri. L2s suna tattara txs da yawa tare don haka kowane mai amfani ya biya yanki na bayanan da aka raba/hujja - sau da yawa zuwa cents.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Babban kudade yana toshe micropayments da madaukai na wasa. Ƙananan kuɗi suna barin mutane na yau da kullun su yi amfani da ƙa'idodi, ba kawai kallon ginshiƙi ba.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Kisa yana faruwa akan L2; Takaitattun bayanai sun buga L1. Blob-era DA yana rage farashin naúrar. L2s na iya yin cunkoso, yawanci ƙasa da kololuwar L1. Kudaden gada da zamewa abubuwa ne daban-daban na layi.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Mai arha ≠ daidai gwargwado. Manufofin kuɗaɗen biyan kuɗi suna siffanta UX. Amincewa da matakai da yawa har yanzu suna haɓaka.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Hadarin zamba don ceton dala biyu rashin hankali ne. Abubuwan damuwa suna daɗa muni duka kudade da lokutan fita.

keyPoints: Amortization + mai rahusa DA matsawar kuɗin tuƙi.

Jimlar farashin ya haɗa da gada, zamewa, da lokaci.
Amintacciya ta doke tsabar kuɗi.
tips: Haɗa kuɗin gada lokacin kwatanta hanyoyi.
Jira spikes don ayyukan da ba na gaggawa ba.
Riƙe ɗan ƙaramin L1 ETH azaman mai tserewa.

name: Kayan aiki
summary: Oracles, ajiya, fihirisa da kayan aikin haɓakawa
blurb: Bututun da ba a iya gani da ke ba da wutar lantarki, DeFi, da mafi aminci UX.

items.title: Oracles
items.summary: Gada waɗanda ke kawo ƙarshen sarkar gaskiya cikin kwangiloli masu wayo
items.intro: Kwangiloli ba za su iya ganin farashin musaya ko maki na zahiri kadai ba. Oracle yana tara bayanan waje don masu ruwa da tsaki, da kuma inshora. Lokacin da suka kasa, cascades suna biyo baya.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Blockchains sun keɓe don ƙaddara, duk da haka kuɗi yana buƙatar bayanai. Oracles suna daidaita sabo da mutunci - ba tare da su galibin DeFi ba.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Abubuwan da aka tattara sun tattara, masu fita waje suna faduwa, sabuntawa suna turawa akan bugun zuciya ko buƙata. Wasu ƙira suna yin gungumen azaba kuma suna kashe masu rahoto mara kyau. Masu satar kewayawa suna cikin hargitsi.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Ƙananan kasuwanni sun fi sauƙi don yin amfani da su don rance mara kyau. Saƙonnin sarƙaƙƙiya matsaloli ne na amintattu kuma.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Samun “baƙi” ≠ rashin rauni. Farashin da ba daidai ba, adadin decimals mara kyau, da ciyarwar da aka dakatar duk cizo.

keyPoints: Oracle shine layin rayuwar DeFi.
Alƙali tushen, tarawa, da sabunta dokoki.
Kadarorin da ba na haram ba sun fi sauƙi don yin zullumi.
Masu watsewar da'ira suna rage fashewar radius.
tips: Sanin wane ciyarwa da bugun zuciya wata yarjejeniya ke amfani da ita.
Rage madaidaicin ayyuka a cikin matsananciyar rashin ƙarfi.
Guji ƙirar tushen tushen guda ɗaya don girma.

items.title: RPC & Nodes
items.summary: Yadda wallet ɗin ke karanta yanayin sarkar da ma'amalolin watsa shirye-shirye
items.intro: Wallets suna magana da blockchain ta hanyar ƙarshen RPC. RPCs na jama'a suna da sauƙi amma ana iya ƙididdige ƙididdigewa, shiga, ko musanya su don phishing. Fahimtar RPC yana taimakawa cire "ma'auni mara kyau" da makale txs.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Ba kowa ke gudanar da cikakken kumburi ba. RPCs suna fallasa iyawar kumburi azaman APIs yayin da suke adana zaɓi don ɗaukar nauyin kai.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Aikace-aikace suna aika kiran JSON-RPC zuwa jihar tambaya ko aika txs. Masu bayarwa sun bambanta akan zurfin adana bayanai, keɓantawa, da aminci.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: RPCs masu mugunta na iya nuna ma'auni na karya ko tantance txs. Sa hannu yana zama na gida, amma munanan bayanai na iya yaudare ku. Tabbatar da sarkar ID lokacin ƙara cibiyoyin sadarwa.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Danna "ƙara cibiyar sadarwa" daga shafukan inuwa yana da haɗari. Ficewar jama'a ba koyaushe kurakurai bane. Kar a taɓa yin sirrin RPC a gaban jama'a.

keyPoints: RPC ita ce kofar karantawa/rubutu.
Sa hannu na cikin gida ≠ amintacce bayyana yanayin.
Bincika mahimman ayyuka akan masu bincike.
Ƙungiyoyin masu zaman kansu/mai ɗaukar nauyin kai suna haɓaka sirri/ dogaro.
tips: Ajiye amintattun madogaran RPC guda biyu.
A kan ma'auni masu ban mamaki, canza nodes ko amfani da mai bincike.
Buga params cibiyar sadarwar hukuma da hannu.

items.title: Indexers
items.summary: Juya danyen rajistan ayyukan cikin APIs samfurin da ake tambaya
items.intro: Ana bincika dukkan sarkar don kowane UI yana jinkirin. Masu ƙididdiga suna shigar da abubuwan da suka faru a cikin ma'ajin bayanai don haka fayiloli da allon jagorori suna jin kai tsaye-mafi yawan ra'ayoyin "tarihi" sun fito ne daga maƙasudi, ba cikakken bincike ba.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Kayayyakin suna buƙatar tace tambayoyin a saurin intanit. Manazarta da bots sun dogara akan layi daya.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Ƙayyade tsari, aiwatar da rajistan ayyukan, adanawa, bautar GraphQL/REST. Wuta yana nuna UI mara nauyi. Rukunin cibiyoyin sadarwa masu ƙima suna ƙarfafa masu aiki da yawa.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: UI na iya rage yanayin sarkar gaskiya. Haɓakawa na buƙatar sabuntawar maƙasudi. Kar a yi ruwa a kan dashboard kadai-tabbatar da sarkar.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Fihirisar cin hanci da rashawa suna yaudarar yan kasuwa. Shafukan “portfolio” na yaudara suna kwaikwayon ainihin dashboards.

keyPoints: Tambayoyin saurin fihirisa; ba ijma'i ba ne.
Bayanan UI na iya zama mara nauyi.
Masu bincike/kwagiloli sune tushen gaskiya don matsananciyar motsi.
Laifin fihirisa yayi kama da kurakuran yarjejeniya.
tips: Sake duba abubuwan da ba a sani ba akan mai bincike.
Yi tsammanin jinkiri bayan manyan haɓakawa.
Saka idanu mai mahimmanci na iya karanta nodes kai tsaye.

items.title: Ma'ajiyar Rarraba
items.summary: Cibiyoyin da aka gabatar da abun ciki don fayiloli da metadata NFT
items.intro: Adana manyan fayiloli akan L1 yana da tsada, don haka kafofin watsa labarai galibi suna zama akan tsarin IPFS/Arweave. Hashes yana tabbatar da mutunci, amma samun kan layi har yanzu yana buƙatar pinning ko dawwama biya.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Sabar tsakiya na iya share kafofin watsa labarai na NFT. Ma'ajiyar da ba ta da tushe tana haɓaka ɗorewa da juriya na ƙididdiga don ƙa'idodi da saitin bayanai.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Fayiloli suna samun ID na abun ciki; dawo da nodes ta hanyar zanta. IPFS yana buƙatar pinning; wasu cibiyoyin sadarwa suna jaddada dawwamar biyan kuɗi sau ɗaya. Ƙofofin HTTP suna taimakawa masu bincike amma ƙara amincewar ƙofar.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Mutable centralized tokenURI yana lalata labarin. Ajiye mahimman hashes metadata.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: "A kan IPFS" ≠ marar mutuwa idan babu abin da ya sanya shi. Ƙofofin ƙeta na iya allurar rubutun. Tabbatar da hashes kafin gudanar da binaries.

keyPoints: Magance abun ciki yana hana gyara shiru, ba sakaci ba.
Dorewar NFT ya dogara da pinning/biya.
URIs masu gudanarwa masu canzawa jaja ne.
Ƙofofin sun dace da ƙarin amana.
tips: Sanya metadata don NFTs masu ƙima da kanka.
Tabbatar da CID na hukuma.
Masu haɓakawa yakamata su fifita metadata maras canzawa.

items.title: MEV
items.summary: Ana iya fitar da ƙima daga odar ciniki da haɗawa
items.intro: Masu gini da masu bincike na iya sake yin oda ko saka txs — sandwiches, tseren ruwa, da ƙari. Masu amfani suna jin shi azaman zamewa mai guba; ladabi suna amsawa tare da gwanjo da kwararar sirri.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Mempools na jama'a suna fallasa manyan musanya ga mafarauta. Fahimtar MEV yana bayyana saitunan zamewa da zaɓuɓɓukan ƙaddamarwa na sirri.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Masu nema suna samun dama; magina shirya tubalan; masu ba da shawara buga. Wasu sarƙoƙi suna sake rarraba MEV ga masu ruwa da tsaki. Sandwiches suna rufe kasuwancin ku don tabarbare farashin.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
sections.body: Filayen zamewa, relays masu zaman kansu, gwanjon batch, da niyya suna rage lahani. Masu jerin L2 na iya fitar da MEV suma.

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta
sections.body: Ba kowane mummunan cika ba ne MEV-fadi zamewa ne da kansa. Guji sketchy "anti-MEV" kari.

keyPoints: MEV yana zuwa daga kwararar jama'a mai tsari.
Masu amfani suna ragewa ta hanyar zamewa da hanyoyi masu zaman kansu.
Ƙirar yarjejeniya ta sake buɗe MEV.

tips: Raba manyan swaps kuma ƙara zamewa.
Yi amfani da walat/masu amfani da hanyoyin sadarwa tare da zaɓuɓɓuka masu zaman kansu.
Ka guji manyan odar kasuwa a cikin kololuwar hargitsi.

items.summary: Sunaye da za a iya karantawa, shaida, da kuma suna don daidaitawar ɗan adam
items.intro: Dogayen adireshi suna da sauƙin kuskure. Tsarin suna taswirar tambarin ɗan adam zuwa rikodin; Ka'idojin shaida suna ba da da'awar kamar zama memba. Amfani yana haɓaka - haka ma keɓantawa da batutuwan kwaikwayi.

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa
sections.body: Biyan kuɗi da bukatun jama'a abin tunawa iyawa. Sunaye suna rage kuskuren canja wuri kuma suna aiki azaman katunan kasuwanci na Web3. Suna yana taimakawa anti-Sybil tare da cinikin sirri.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki

items.summary: Madogarawa na ɗan adam wanda za'a iya karantawa waɗanda ke sabunta maɓallan walat

sections.heading: Wace matsala take magancewa

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: BIP-39 yana juya entropy zuwa kalmomin da aka ba da umarni waɗanda ke samun asusu. Kuskuren oda ya kasa dawowa. Kalmomin wucewa na zaɓi suna ƙara tsaro da haɗarin mantuwa.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci

sections.heading: Hatsari & rashin fahimta

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci

items.intro: DAOs suna tura haɓakawa da yanke shawara na baitulmali zuwa masu riƙon alama ko tsarin suna. Alamu ɗaya-ɗaya-ƙiri mai sauƙi ne kuma mai saurin kifin kifi; wakilai da sauran kayayyaki suna ƙoƙarin inganta wakilci. Ikon kada kuri'a shine tasiri-kuma saman kai hari.

sections.heading: Yadda yake aiki
sections.body: Shawara → tattaunawa → zabe → kulle lokaci → aiwatarwa. Tawagar tana barin ƙananan masu riko su amince da masana. Ƙorums da vetoes sun fito ba da ƙarfi ba.

sections.heading: Mabuɗin mahimmanci
